text:
maya: ok this is it. Kai discovered the golden curtain sunspot and refuses to move. sending live evidence. 
snap-bot: uploaded image: kai_curtain_glow.jpg (1024x768) 
henry: that loaf is soaked in sunlight. crispy edges. :yum: 
zoe: he looks like a tiny, furry lighthouse. 
arjun: question: is this an acceptable excuse to delay meetings for 10 minutes? asking for my calendar. :face_with_hand_over_mouth: 
maya: policy update: 10-minute solar naps are company-sanctioned. doc coming. :laughing: 
henry: trade: i'll bring espresso if kai moves for a pet. 
zoe: in-person bribe accepted. also someone invent a "sunbeam tracker" so we can schedule naps strategically. 
arjun: i nominate the sunbeam tracker for Q2 hackathon. :raised_hands: 
snap-bot: reaction :heart_eyes: added by zoe 
maya: @henry i'll take the espresso but only if you bring tiny sunglasses for kai. 
henry: tiny sunglasses or tiny hat? decisions. 
zoe: sunglasses. more aerodynamic for nap drafts. 
arjun: vote: sunglasses = 3, hat = 0 so sunglasses it is. 
maya: thanks team. Kai will remain a curtain monarch until further notice. please send all virtual scratches and adoration. :paw_prints:
